authoritative_reference.title: IUPAC Blue Book P-13.1: substitutive operation

rules.meaning: A parent H is exchanged for the substituent, forming its attachment bond.
rules.structural_implications: A parent H is exchanged for the substituent, forming its attachment bond.
rules.applicability_boundaries: Only one N1 substitution; no suffix or additional operations.
rules.known_limitations: Does not establish complete identity or all mobile-H states.

authoritative_reference.title: IUPAC Blue Book P-14.3.2: placement of locants

rules.meaning: A locant immediately precedes the naming unit it modifies.
rules.structural_implications: A locant immediately precedes the naming unit it modifies.
rules.applicability_boundaries: Only numeric 1 and unambiguous single parent ownership.
rules.known_limitations: Does not establish complete identity or all mobile-H states.

authoritative_reference.title: IUPAC Blue Book P-14.7.1: indicated hydrogen

rules.meaning: The source descriptor specifies a parent mancude-ring state; it is not a final hydrogen-count instruction.
rules.structural_implications: The source descriptor specifies a parent mancude-ring state; it is not a final hydrogen-count instruction.
rules.applicability_boundaries: One explicit 1H; added H and other H locants excluded.
rules.known_limitations: Does not establish complete identity or all mobile-H states.

authoritative_reference.title: IUPAC Blue Book P-22.2, Table 2.2: retained parent hydrides and numbering

rules.meaning: The defined parent and its numbering determine which atom is N1.
rules.structural_implications: The defined parent and its numbering determine which atom is N1.
rules.applicability_boundaries: Only 1H-pyrazole and 1H-imidazole; extensions require independently reviewed numbered templates.
rules.known_limitations: Does not establish complete identity or all mobile-H states.

authoritative_reference.title: IUPAC Blue Book P-29: substituent-group names

rules.meaning: A methyl, ethyl, propyl or butyl prefix provides a terminal single attachment of a straight carbon chain.
rules.structural_implications: A methyl, ethyl, propyl or butyl prefix provides a terminal single attachment of a straight carbon chain.
rules.applicability_boundaries: Unbranched C1-C4 only; no unsupported alkyl naming variants.
rules.known_limitations: Does not establish complete identity or all mobile-H states.
